plugins.name: notion-skills
plugins.description: Use a Notion database as your personal, agent-agnostic skill store. Register skills as Notion pages (name + trigger keywords + instructions); this plugin routes matching Claude Code requests to them and keeps a local registry in sync — while Notion AI and other agents consume the same skills directly.
